areas.t: On Sunday, November 22nd, expect moderate air quality in  Vermont due to a combination of thermal inversions trapping local pollutants overnight, and slightly elevated levels of fine particulate matter (PM25) across the region.  Pollutant levels will drop when rain occurs later in the day or evening
